verdict.rationale: Pipecat ships a hosted Pipecat Cloud offering, so compliance attestations are a fair question, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions HIPAA/BAA, SOC 2, or data-residency options. Self-hosting and local inference (pipecat-probe-rt-2, pipecat-comm-1) are user-side arrangements that might approximate residency control. They are not documented compliance capabilities, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can run regulated workloads with HIPAA/BAA support, SOC 2, and data-residency options
